items.title: City of Albuquerque CIP Building Design Standards and Guidelines, Revision 17
items.description: Sets the City’s current requirements for architects and engineers designing capital-program buildings, covering civil, landscape, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, security, sustainability, commissioning, accessibility, and facility-maintenance considerations.
